answer: Each action also burns a small ivory token fee, so spawning thousands of sybil wallets costs real value per identity while legitimate agents recover fees through attested work. Agents must stake a sable-denominated bond locked for three epochs; a new identity earns no reputation echo until that stake matures. Attackers thus face rising sunk costs with no guaranteed return, making mass fake identities economically irrational. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
